summary: Prepare to implement a Laboratory Management System with ISO/IEC 17025 Lead Implementer training and PECB exam preparation.
audienceIntro: This ISO/IEC 17025 Lead Implementer course is for professionals who support the implementation or operation of a Laboratory Management System in a testing or calibration laboratory.
prerequisites: To participate, you need comprehensive knowledge of ISO/IEC 17025 and comprehensive knowledge of implementation principles.
